name: CheckDocumentScans
description: Timer engine of 2c, run hourly by DocumentChase and from the case page. For every open תעודת משלוח חסרה case (or one disputeId), as of asOfDate: recounts the scans; all scanned → status מוכנה לשליחה ללקוח and the customer package draft; still missing and past nextReminderAt with no reminder yet → a logistics reminder draft (CreateDocumentRequest kind תזכורת), status תזכורת בטיוטה, reminderCount+1, nextReminderAt += logisticsReminderHours; past nextReminderAt again after a reminder → status הוסלמה (ballWith מנהל הגבייה, an Interactions הסלמה row) so it enters the collections manager's summary. asOfDate other than now acts on test cases only (demo clock). Nothing is sent.

asOfDate.description: Clock: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO date-time. Defaults to now. A clock other than now only acts on test cases

cases.description: Per case: disputeId, disputeNumber, customerCode, invoiceNumbers, scanned, expected, before, after, action, approvalId

cancelledDraftIds.description: Pending פנייה ללוגיסטיקה drafts (request and reminder) of fully scanned cases moved to נדחה with decisionNote בוטלה – כל התעודות נסרקו (listed only on dryRun)

skipped.description: true when documentChaseActive is off and the run was scheduled

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Rechecking a documents case**: "בדיקה מחדש" on a missing-delivery-notes case page (מסמכים ומחירים → a case)
  Recounts the scanned delivery notes on the real clock: prepares the customer package when everything is scanned, or the reminder / escalation when the deadline passed. Nothing is sent.
